summary: Admin Platform Phase 1 testing completed. Backend: 17/18 tests passed (94%). Frontend: All 4 sections working correctly with proper i18n support (CA/ES/EN).

minor.issue: Was returning relative URL '/api/whatsapp/webhook' instead of full URL. FIXED by adding BASE_URL to backend/.env

backend: GET /api/admin/setup/check - Returns all_ready:true with all 5 tables (tenants, whatsapp_accounts, whatsapp_secrets, whatsapp_webhook_logs, audit_logs) status 'ok'
GET /api/admin/whatsapp-account - Returns account with all fields (account_name, business_name, phone_number_id, connection_status, webhook_status, token_status)
PUT /api/admin/whatsapp-account - Updates account fields and returns updated data
POST /api/admin/whatsapp-account/validate - Calls Meta API and returns valid:true with data
GET /api/admin/whatsapp-secrets - Returns masked secrets (has_access_token, masked_access_token) - never full values
PUT /api/admin/whatsapp-secrets - Encrypts and saves credentials with Fernet encryption
POST /api/admin/whatsapp-secrets/test-connection - Tests stored token against Meta API
GET /api/admin/webhook-info - Returns webhook_url, verify_token, webhook_status, last_events
GET /api/admin/audit-logs - Returns logged actions with action_type, entity_type, description, created_at
Admin role (admin@workshoppartsdesk.com) - Can access all /api/admin/* endpoints
Super admin role (superadmin@workshoppartsdesk.com) - Can access all /api/admin/* endpoints
Super admin without tenant_id - Returns null account and empty audit logs (expected behavior)
frontend: Admin page loads at /admin route with sidebar containing 4 sections
Account section shows form with all WhatsApp config fields (account_name, business_name, phone_number_id, display_phone_number, etc.)
Account section shows 3 status badges (connection_status, webhook_status, token_status)
Account section has Save, Validate connection, Disconnect, Refresh status buttons
Credentials section shows masked values with show/hide toggle
Credentials section has password inputs for access_token, app_secret, verify_token
Credentials section has Save credentials and Test connection buttons
Webhook section shows full webhook URL with Copy URL button
Webhook section shows verify token with Copy token button
Webhook section shows verification status badge and Mark as verified button
Audit logs section shows action history table with columns: Action, Entity, Description, Date
Nav header shows Admin button for admin/super_admin roles
